name: Pit Fiend
damageResistances: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.text: The spider can see 60 feet into the Ethe- real Plane while on the Material Plane and vice versa.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The spider makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target becomes Stable, and it has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While Poisoned, the target also has the Paralyzed condition. Bonus Actions

actions.name: Ethereal Jaunt
actions.text: The spider teleports from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa. Pirates Pirate Medium or Small Humanoid, Neutral

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The pirate makes two Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Enthrall- ing Panache.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enthralling Panache
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate’s next turn. Pirate Captain Medium or Small Humanoid, Neutral

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the pirate has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage. Bonus Actions Captain’s Charm. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate’s next turn.

reactions.name: Riposte
reactions.text: Trigger: The pirate is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The pirate adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the pirate makes one Rapier attack against the triggering creature if within range. Pit Fiend Pit Fiend
